component.name: Pelican
component.summary: Put your own music on a Garmin watch. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.

description.p: Pelican moves your own music files onto a Garmin watch over a USB cable. Point it at a folder of music and it tags, converts every file to one known-good MP3 profile, uploads, and reads each file back to prove it landed intact — without going through Garmin Express, iTunes, or any cloud service, and without a vendor account.
Privacy-first by design. The binary makes zero network connections. Your music stays on your computer; your fitness data stays on your watch. Nothing leaves either unless you decide.
A Krypteia tool — part of an effort to give people open-source alternatives to subscription-only platforms.

ul.li: FLAC, WAV, ALAC/AAC, MP3, OGG, Opus, AIFF, WMA and more are all converted to one profile: MP3, 192 kbps CBR, 44.1 kHz stereo, ID3v2.3
Tags missing from a file are filled from its folder and file name
Every file is sent under a name never used on that watch before, then read back and hashed
Per-device ledger of every name sent (persists across runs)
A single command-line binary with no daemon and no telemetry
Command-line tool: push, status, ls, ledger
ffmpeg-based audio normalization to Garmin-compatible MP3
Per-device ledger of every name sent
